59/S0.subgoal: Describe the objectives and scope of the Majuli VR case study.

59/S1.subgoal: Explain the vast and multimodal data requirements for an immersive VR tour.

59/S2.subgoal: Describe the computational challenges involved in rendering massive, multimodal VR content.

59/S3.subgoal: Compare cloud-based optimization and its associated network concerns using the Oculus Quest 2 example.
